passages.sermon: This is a song.\r\nPeople sing this song while going up to Jerusalem.\r\nThey call it a song of ascents.

passages.text: O LORD, remember on behalf of David all the hardships he endured, how he swore an oath to the LORD, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob: “I will not enter my house or get into my bed, I will not give sleep to my eyes or slumber to my eyelids, until I find a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
passages.sermon:
This is a song of ascents.
David was the king of Israel.
David suffered many hardships.
O LORD, remember David.
Remember all his hardships.
David swore an oath to the LORD.
David made a vow to the Mighty One of Jacob.
He said, “I will not enter my house.
I will not get into my bed.
I will not give sleep to my eyes.
I will not let my eyelids slumber.
I will do this until I find a place for the LORD.
I will do this until I find a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
passages.original: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹת זְכוֹר־ יְהוָ֥ה לְדָוִ֑ד אֵ֝ת כָּל־ עֻנּוֹתֽוֹ׃ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִ֭שְׁבַּע לַיהוָ֑ה נָ֝דַ֗ר לַאֲבִ֥יר יַעֲקֹֽב׃ אִם־ אָ֭בֹא בְּאֹ֣הֶל בֵּיתִ֑י אִם־ אֶ֝עֱלֶ֗ה עַל־ עֶ֥רֶשׂ יְצוּעָֽי׃ אִם־ אֶתֵּ֣ן שְׁנַ֣ת לְעֵינָ֑י לְֽעַפְעַפַּ֥י תְּנוּמָֽה׃ עַד־ אֶמְצָ֣א מָ֭קוֹם לַיהוָ֑ה מִ֝שְׁכָּנ֗וֹת לַאֲבִ֥יר יַעֲקֹֽב׃

passages.text: We heard that the ark was in Ephrathah; we found it in the fields of Jaar.
passages.sermon: The ark is the sacred chest of God.\r\nWe heard about the ark in Ephrathah.\r\nWe found the ark in the fields of Jaar.
passages.original: הִנֵּֽה־ שְׁמַֽעֲנ֥וּהָ בְאֶפְרָ֑תָה מְ֝צָאנ֗וּהָ בִּשְׂדֵי־ יָֽעַר׃

passages.text: Let us go to His dwelling place; let us worship at His footstool.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God has a dwelling place.
Let us go to God's dwelling place.
God has a footstool.
Let us worship at God's footstool.

passages.text: Arise, O LORD, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your strength.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The people speak to the LORD.
They ask the LORD to arise.
They ask the LORD to go to His resting place.
They ask the LORD to go with the ark.
The ark shows the LORD’s strength.
The people want the LORD and the ark to be together in the resting place.
passages.original: קוּמָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה לִמְנוּחָתֶ֑ךָ אַ֝תָּ֗ה וַאֲר֥וֹן עֻזֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: May Your priests be clothed with righteousness, and Your saints shout for joy.
passages.sermon:
God has priests.
God’s priests wear righteousness.
God has saints.
God’s saints shout for joy.

passages.text: For the sake of Your servant David, do not reject Your anointed one.
passages.sermon:
God made David His servant.
God chose David to serve Him.
God anointed a chosen one from David’s line.
God, do not reject Your anointed one.
God, remember David’s faithfulness.
God, act for David’s sake.
passages.original: בַּ֭עֲבוּר דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ אַל־ תָּ֝שֵׁ֗ב פְּנֵ֣י מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: The LORD swore an oath to David, a promise He will not revoke: “One of your descendants I will place on your throne.
passages.sermon:
The LORD made a promise to David.
The LORD swore an oath to David.
The LORD will not break this promise.
The LORD said this promise is true.
The LORD said, “I will place one of your descendants on your throne.”
passages.original: נִשְׁבַּֽע־ יְהוָ֨ה׀ לְדָוִ֡ד אֱמֶת֮ לֹֽא־ יָשׁ֪וּב מִ֫מֶּ֥נָּה מִפְּרִ֥י בִטְנְךָ֑ אָ֝שִׁ֗ית לְכִסֵּא־ לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: If your sons keep My covenant and the testimony I will teach them, then their sons will also sit on your throne forever and ever.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to David.
God made a promise to David.
God said, “If your sons obey My covenant, they will be blessed.
If your sons keep the testimony I teach them, I will bless them.
If your sons obey Me, their children will also be blessed.
Your sons and their descendants will sit on your throne forever.”
passages.original: אִֽם־ יִשְׁמְר֬וּ בָנֶ֨יךָ׀ בְּרִיתִי֮ וְעֵדֹתִ֥י ז֗וֹ אֲלַ֫מְּדֵ֥ם גַּם־ בְּנֵיהֶ֥ם עֲדֵי־ עַ֑ד יֵ֝שְׁב֗וּ לְכִסֵּא־ לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: For the LORD has chosen Zion; He has desired it for His home: “This is My resting place forever and ever; here I will dwell, for I have desired this home.
passages.sermon:
The LORD chose Zion.
The LORD wanted Zion for His home.
The LORD said, “This is My resting place forever.
I will live here.
I have desired this place.”
passages.original: כִּֽי־ בָחַ֣ר יְהוָ֣ה בְּצִיּ֑וֹן אִ֝וָּ֗הּ לְמוֹשָׁ֥ב לֽוֹ׃ זֹאת־ מְנוּחָתִ֥י עֲדֵי־ עַ֑ד פֹּֽה־ אֵ֝שֵׁ֗ב כִּ֣י אִוִּתִֽיהָ׃

passages.text: I will bless her with abundant provisions; I will satisfy her poor with bread.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about Zion.
God promises to bless Zion.
God will give Zion abundant provisions.
God will satisfy the poor people in Zion.
God will give them enough bread.
passages.original: צֵ֭ידָהּ בָּרֵ֣ךְ אֲבָרֵ֑ךְ אֶ֝בְיוֹנֶ֗יהָ אַשְׂבִּ֥יעַֽ לָֽחֶם׃

passages.text: I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her saints will sing out in joy.
passages.sermon:
The LORD chose Zion.
The LORD desired Zion for His home.
The LORD said, “This is My resting place forever.”
The LORD will dwell in Zion.
The LORD will bless Zion.
The LORD will satisfy the poor in Zion with bread.
The LORD will clothe Zion’s priests with salvation.
The LORD will cause Zion’s faithful people to sing with joy.
passages.original: וְֽ֭כֹהֲנֶיהָ אַלְבִּ֣ישׁ יֶ֑שַׁע וַ֝חֲסִידֶ֗יהָ רַנֵּ֥ן יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃

passages.text: There I will make a horn grow for David; I have prepared a lamp for My anointed one.
passages.sermon:
God speaks in this passage.
God promises to act in a specific place.
God will make a horn grow for David.
The horn represents strength and power.
God has prepared a lamp for His anointed one.
The lamp represents guidance and blessing for the chosen king.
passages.original: שָׁ֤ם אַצְמִ֣יחַ קֶ֣רֶן לְדָוִ֑ד עָרַ֥כְתִּי נֵ֝֗ר לִמְשִׁיחִֽי׃

passages.text: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but the crown upon him will gleam.”
passages.sermon:
God speaks about David and his anointed one.
God says, “I will clothe his enemies with shame.
His enemies will feel disgrace.
The crown on my anointed one will shine.
The crown will gleam brightly on him.”
passages.original: א֭וֹיְבָיו אַלְבִּ֣ישׁ בֹּ֑שֶׁת וְ֝עָלָ֗יו יָצִ֥יץ נִזְרֽוֹ׃
